notes: restore-required because of oca-addons/contract 18.0.2.0.0. That migration is an OCA major-version restructure: it moves a dozen contract.line fields out to contract_line_successor and contract_termination, deletes the contract_template_line_form_view, and removes ir_model rows for four abstract models. Once it has run, the previous image is looking for fields and a view that are no longer where it expects them, so rolling the image back does not roll the database back. Recovery from a failed upgrade is restore-from-backup, not image revert. Every other migration in this release is additive -- the Majal ones write data and install record rules, the remaining OCA ones add columns -- and on their own would have been forward-compatible. Note the trigger: this only fires when upgrading a database whose contract module predates 18.0.2.0.0. A first install on an empty database registers 18.0.2.0.0 directly and runs no migration at all, so the first go-live deployment is not exposed to it. majal_demo 18.0.2.0.1 was added in 8cda8e7: it re-invokes post_init_hook on upgrade, because that hook only runs on first install and demo databases that already carried an older majal_demo would otherwise get the new code without the Property, office, approval and signing records. It creates records and changes no schema, so it does not move the flag; the flag remains restore-required for the oca contract reason above. Two things to know operationally: upgrading a database that has majal_demo installed will seed the full acceptance dataset into it, and the seeder is documented as idempotent but that idempotency is asserted by its author rather than verified here.
